projectState.summary: Byte 16b-a is ready for Claude review on codex/byte-16b-a. The Form Score panel now exposes deterministic app-owned form variants: Classic Arc, Early Hook, and Wide Return. Variants combine a song arrangement with a section-dynamics profile; the selected variant drives transport arrangement, harmonic context, playback section decisions, and form scoring through the existing lookahead path. Classic Arc remains the default, Early Hook reaches chorus at beat 16 for an audible A/B, and variant changes refresh lookahead while clearing stale slow-thinking playback. Validation: build, db:smoke, full app smoke 32/32, and diff-check are green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisory.
